paragraphs: Shimi (Shimi son of Gera, II Samuel 16:5).
The elder son of Shimon the Righteous, Menachot 109b; see the entry Shimon the Righteous.

notes.text: The source’s Biblical locator פ״טו-יה remains unresolved and is not rendered as a chapter range. The notice does not equate the Biblical Shimi with Shimon the Righteous’s son.

The saved whole Miqra according to the Masorah II Samuel16:5 verse explicitly names Shimi son of Gera. It supplies a biblical comparison without proving the letters of source פ״טו-יה or establishing that malformed locator as a chapter range. The biblical namesake and Shimon the Righteous’s son remain distinct, and no broader first-occurrence search is claimed.

Hyman’s printed notice (vol. III, p. 1228) gives II Samuel 16:5. The supplied transcription has the malformed locator פ״טו-יה. The verse names the biblical Shimi son of Gera. In Menachot 109b, both accounts call the other Shimi two and a half years older than Chonyo, while they differ on who was jealous of whom.
